description: Requires a JWT or an rk_ key (sign in headlessly with auth_wallet_challenge → auth_wallet_verify). Starts the Lab month — $29.99 a month, full access to everything: the runtime, the Lab, 300 runs a day (model steps on your own model key) — for YOURSELF; it never names another account. rail 'usdc' + payer_wallet returns exact pay instructions (send EXACTLY that USDC from payer_wallet; it confirms on its own; the order expires in 48 hours unpaid). rail 'sol' + payer_wallet quotes the month in exact base units (the quote holds 60 seconds; send exactly that amount). rail 'card' returns a Stripe Checkout link for a person. All payments are final, no refunds; to cancel a month, email admin@rokha.ai. Then subscription_status shows when it is active. Cheaper start: 5 free runs a day signed in, then a run pack (100 runs for $1, product_checkout).
